2608.22817.title: Industrial-Instruction: An End-to-End Framework for Building Instruction-Tuning and Benchmark Datasets from Industrial Technical Reports
2608.22817.paper_summary: Industrial technical reports contain high-value knowledge for maintenance, troubleshooting, and product engineering, but their heterogeneous structure (dense prose, specifications, tables) makes them difficult to index and reason over with standard retrieval and QA pipelines, and no public instruction-tuning or benchmark datasets are built from such documents. We address this gap with Industrial-Instruction, contributing (i) two open QA datasets built from real industrial technical reports and (ii) the end-to-end pipeline that produces them. Using 906 public Panasonic documents (7,525 pages), we apply layout-aware extraction, build a semantic retrieval index, and synthesize multiple-choice QA grounded in retrieved evidence under five query-document relationships (irrelevant retrieval, single-/multi-document support, single-/multi-document answer). After filtering an initial 23.9k generated samples, each dataset provides approximately 13.6k QA pairs with source documents and a held-out benchmark split. Fine-tuning small open LLMs (under 10B parameters) improves Set-Match Accuracy from 28.5% to 42.0% and F1 from 46.6% to 63.5% on the Panasonic benchmark. We release two parallel versions built by the same pipeline: one generated with the open-weight Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct model and one with the closed, API-based Claude-Opus-4.6 model, enabling a direct comparison of open- versus frontier-model data generation. The Claude-Opus-4.6 dataset yields a cleaner raw corpus and larger fine-tuning gains, at roughly two orders of magnitude higher cost. MMLU evaluation shows models trained on the Claude-Opus-4.6 data retain essentially all general knowledge, versus a small but measurable forgetting effect for the Qwen-generated data. Together, these datasets and pipeline offer a practical, reproducible path toward scalable industrial benchmarks and training data from real-world documentation.
2608.22817.paper_summary_zh: 工業技術報告包含維護、故障排除和產品工程的高價值知識，但其異質結構（密集的散文、規格、表格）使得使用標準檢索和質量保證管道進行索引和推理變得困難，並且沒有公共的指令調整或基準數據集是由這類文件構建的。我們通過 Industrial-Instruction 解決了這一空白，貢獻了 (i) 兩個基於真實工業技術報告構建的開放式質量保證數據集，以及 (ii) 生成這些數據集的端到端管道。使用 906 份公開的松下文件（7,525 頁），我們應用佈局感知提取，建立語義檢索索引，並在五種查詢-文檔關係下合成基於檢索證據的多選質量保證（無關檢索、單/多文檔支持、單/多文檔答案）。在過濾掉最初的 23.9k 生成樣本後，每個數據集提供大約 13.6k 的質量保證對，並附有源文檔和一個保留的基準拆分。微調小型開放 LLM（少於 10B 參數）將 Set-Match 準確度從 28.5% 提高到 42.0%，F1 從 46.6% 提高到 63.5%，在松下基準上。我們釋放了兩個由相同管道構建的平行版本：一個是使用開放權重的 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct 模型生成的，另一個是使用封閉的基於 API 的 Claude-Opus-4.6 模型生成的，這使得開放模型與前沿模型數據生成之間的直接比較成為可能。Claude-Opus-4.6 數據集產生了更乾淨的原始語料庫和更大的微調增益，成本大約高出兩個數量級。MMLU 評估顯示，基於 Claude-Opus-4.6 數據訓練的模型基本上保留了所有一般知識，而 Qwen 生成的數據則存在小但可測量的遺忘效應。這些數據集和管道共同提供了一條實用的、可重複的途徑，朝向從現實世界文檔中獲得可擴展的工業基準和訓練數據。
